mcp_tools.name: verified_place_shortlist
mcp_tools.title: Verified place shortlist
mcp_tools.description: Submits a verified place shortlist record (constraint declarations, declared criterion rows, declared place rows with declared verification evidence, evaluation declarations, ranking declarations, freshness and uncertainty handling declarations, red lines) and returns a deterministic VERIFIED_PLACE_SHORTLIST_SOUND / VERIFIED_PLACE_SHORTLIST_NOT_SOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six sections, including computed criterion-to-place coverage, per-row evidence completeness and winner and backup resolution checks over the declared rows, with per-check evidence. Audits the declared shortlist record only; it fetches nothing live, verifies no real-world fact and recommends or books nothing. The word verified in its name refers to the caller's declared verification discipline, not to any live verification by the atom.

inputSchema.description: The verified place shortlist manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and row schemas).
